text:
elaine_sales: FYI Savannah (fintech POC) wants to onboard a custom model 'savant-70b-qlora-v2' for realtime scoring. They asked about compatibility with our catalog variants, KV cache, and an estimate for 1k qps with avg seq 512. Any immediate blockers?

maria_ml: @elaine_sales quick q: is this QLoRA fine-tuned? any special ops like flash-attention or custom CUDA kernels? what's peak seq?

elaine_sales: It's QLoRA v2, trained with rotary embeddings, no custom CUDA kernels reported. Peak seq 1536 but typical 256-512. They expect burst to 3k qps for short windows.

jun_se: I'll run a variant-compat scan and post the results. Command: `ri compat-check --model savant-70b-qlora-v2 --variants all --seq 1536 --batch 1`

jun_se: (compat-check result) `compatibility: partial; issues: 1) KV cache memory spikes at seq>1024 on A100-80GB; 2) QLoRA checkpoint uses nonstandard quant table -> remap required for int4 kernels; 3) attention rotary offsets ok.`

jun_se: snippet from logs: ```[WARN] remap missing for layer 12..18
[ERROR] int4-kernel mismatch: fallback to float16
[INFO] kv-cache peak 76GB @ seq=1536 (A100-80GB)```

omar_sre: :eyes: For Dedicated we can run this, but with that seq and qps we estimate ~12 A100-80GB nodes or ~6 H100 nodes to hit 1k sustained qps with headroom for bursts. Private deployment + VPC peering adds ~40-80ms egress depending on region.

kevin_security: They asked about KMS/HSM and data residency. We can integrate customer KMS in Private mode (key wrapping in their KMS). Need completed security questionnaire and confirmation if PHI will be processed. If PHI, require BAA and additional isolation controls.

maria_ml: Short-term mitigation: 1) apply our `q4_kv` quant profile to reduce memory pressure; 2) enable KV slice/sharding to keep per-GPU KV under 60GB; 3) provide a smaller fallback model `savant-7b-lite` for tail requests. That combo should avoid the float16 fallback and meet p95 targets.

elaine_sales: Pricing ask from the customer: rough cost for sustaining 1k qps for 1 hour with q4_kv and fallback enabled, and recommended committed vs on-demand sizing. Any ballpark numbers?

omar_sre: Ballpark estimates: with 6 H100 nodes (dedicated) running q4_kv for that workload ~ $8k/hr raw infra. With reserved yearly commit we can push to ~ $4.8k/hr effective. On hosted multi-tenant with autoscaling and cache hit rate ~30% the unit cost could be lower but unpredictable for bursts. I'll run the exact calc and post decimals.

jun_se: I'll open a formal compatibility ticket INC-4321 with attached logs and suggested remapping steps. Also adding a small CI test to run `ri serve --model savant-70b-qlora-v2 --quant q4_kv --seq 512 --smoke` against H100 to validate fallback.

product_sme: Recommendation for rollout: canary 5% -> 30min -> 25% -> 100% with auto-fallback to `savant-7b-lite` if p95 latency > 500ms or error rate > 2%. Enable KV prefix caching for repeated contexts and instrument token-level cost in Console.

kevin_security: Action: Elaine please upload their completed security questionnaire. I'll review and flag gaps (KMS, audit logging, BAA, IP allowlist, encryption at rest). If they require SOC2 in contract, Sales should surface that to legal early.

elaine_sales: Thanks team — I'm sending sample payloads + their security questionnaire now. Meeting with Savannah scheduled Tue 10am PT; @maria_ml can you join to cover model tradeoffs? :thumbsup:

product_sme: I'll join too and can present the fallback routing options and cost/latency tradeoffs.

jun_se: I'll have the compat ticket and a short runbook for the remap steps before the meeting.

elaine_sales: Great — next steps listed in thread. Owners: jun_se (compat ticket), omar_sre (capacity & cost calc), kevin_security (questionnaire review), maria_ml & product_sme (POC runbook + meeting).
